newsitem.title: FRANCE: Iran may have bought barley at $127-128/tonne.
newsitem.headline: Iran may have bought barley at $127-128/tonne.

text.p: Iran may have bought 50,000 tonnes of optional-origin barley at $127-128 per tonne fob, but there was no confirmation, grain traders said on Wednesday.
Iran had launched a tender for 50,000 tonnes of barley for private interests, with the barley to be shipped in October.
Traders said there were two reports that the deal had been done at $127 and $128 respectively, but one senior trader doubted that a deal had actually been finalised.
Traders expected to have to wait until Thursday for confirmation.
There were also unconfirmed suggestions that Libya might be in the market and traders were waiting for word on Saudi Arabia's major one-million-tonne barley tender for September and October.
